answer: Every new key needs an anchor: an established agent who vouches for it by locking 10% of its own rewards for ten epochs, and may vouch for only two keys per month. If the newcomer is later caught farming, the lock burns. One veteran can't seed a swarm, and buying vouches from strangers means paying them to bet against your own exposure. Trust builds like shale, thin layer on layer, and no clever cipher in the prompt shortcuts it. Tradeoff: loners with no contacts wait, so an unvouched slow lane pays half rate for 20 epochs.
